name: Dried squid
summary: Mực khô is dried squid, white on the belly and pale pink on the back, with faint dark spots. Grilled and torn, the meat is pale pink and chewy.
origin: Thanh Khê’s squid-jigging boats. The grilled plate is at Con Market’s outdoor counters.
texture: Once grilled and torn, the meat is pale pink, chewy, and holds together.
howToEat: Grill it and tear it. Con Market serves grilled dried squid on the outdoor counters.
To buy it dried, Hạng Huệ dries squid at 145 Kỳ Đồng, Thanh Khê Đông.
where: Con Market’s outdoor counters, from about 15:00.
Hạng Huệ, 145 Kỳ Đồng, Thanh Khê Đông.
